spans.s:
मुमुक्षा f. (-क्षा)
 1. Desire of liberation.
 2. Desire of final emancipation.

मुमुक्षु m. (-क्षुः)
 1. A sage, abstracted from all human passion and feel-
ing, and preparing himself for eternal emancipation.
 2. Any one
anxious for liberation, especially from mundane existence.
 E. मुच्
to liberate, in the desiderative form, उ aff.

मुमुषिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to steal.
 E. मुष् to steal, desid. v., उ aff.

मुमुषिषुवत् Ind. Like a thief.
 E. मुमु, षिषुवति aff.

मुमूर्षा f. (-र्षा) Wish to die, impatience of life.
 E. मृ to die, desid v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

मुमूर्षु m. (-र्षुः) A man at the point of the death, a dying-man.
 E. मृ to
die, desiderative or expectative form, and उ aff.
